newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisia buys 100,000 T barley, 50,000 T soft wheat.
newsitem.headline: Tunisia buys 100,000 T barley, 50,000 T soft wheat.

text.p: Tunisia bought four lots of barley of 25,000 tonnes each and two lots of soft wheat of 25,000 tonnes each at a tender on Tuesday, traders said.
Prices for barley were at $147.87 per tonne C&F for each lot at the following shipment dates -- January 20-31 1997, February 10-20, March 10-20 and April 10-20.
Prices for the soft wheat were $164.33 per tonne C&F for a shipment by January 20-31 and $163.33 for February 20-28.
